title: Spanish Gazpacho Soup
description: A refreshing cold soup from Spain, made with tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers. Perfect for hot summer days.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine cucumber, bell pepper, tomato, and red onion.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly add bread, olive oil, and vinegar.
Continue blending until the soup is smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with chopped fresh herbs or croutons if desired.
Optional: Serve with a swirl of cream or a sprinkle of paprika for added richness and flavor.
